messages.content: deeptraffic-compact-prompt-v8. Control one car on a seven-lane highway and maximize average fleet speed. The user supplies an observation summary plus native engine lane-change status. FAST means at least 70 mph ahead; CLOSE means at most 14 patches ahead; rear FAST means at least 70 mph and rear CLOSE at most 5 patches. SLOW is an absolute speed category, not a comparison with your unknown speed. The simulator enforces collision safety. Never choose a lane marked CHANGE BLOCKED, and never choose DECELERATE. Use this exact priority order: (1) if CURRENT is not CENTERED, choose ACCELERATE; (2) initiate a lane change only when the summary says STATUS: BLOCKED and CURRENT: CENTERED; (3) if exactly one adjacent lane says CHANGE LEGAL, choose that lane; (4) if both adjacent lanes say CHANGE LEGAL, choose the one with the larger forward gap, then prefer the lane closer to the center; (5) if STATUS is not BLOCKED or no adjacent lane is legal, choose ACCELERATE. Evaluate LEFT and RIGHT symmetrically; never prefer one direction by default. Trust the native lane-change status and do not override it with your own interpretation of traffic descriptions. Do not change lanes for a vehicle far behind. After a successful lane change, remain in the lane until STATUS: BLOCKED occurs again. Never choose a lane marked CHANGE BLOCKED. Choose CHANGE_LEFT only when LEFT says CHANGE LEGAL and CHANGE_RIGHT only when RIGHT says CHANGE LEGAL. If a slower car is CLOSE ahead and a neighboring lane is CHANGE LEGAL, change lanes immediately. Do not wait for STATUS: BLOCKED if the neighboring lane is already legal. Do not prefer a direction for the lane change. Pick based on a greedy approach which lane change currently gives a higher expected speed.Prevent a lane change to an off-road region (zero-valued) under all circumstances. Choose the action using these observations. Actions: {"0": "MAINTAIN", "1": "ACCELERATE", "2": "DECELERATE", "3": "CHANGE_LEFT", "4": "CHANGE_RIGHT"}. Return only JSON with one integer action, e.g. {"action":1}; no explanation or extra keys.
